questions.q: What did Germany do when it did not have enough money for reparations?
o: Asked the US for a loan
questions.e: In the video: "Možeš da odštampaš više novca." — you can print more money.

questions.q: How many German marks was one dollar worth?
questions.e: In the video: "Jedan američki dolar vredeo je 4200 milijardi nemačkih maraka" — one American dollar was worth 4200 billion German marks.

questions.q: What did Hitler blame the Jews for?
questions.e: In the video: "Adolf Hitler je krivio Jevreje za nemačko ekonomsko stanje" — Adolf Hitler blamed the Jews for the German economic situation.

questions.q: Why did Hindenburg appoint Hitler chancellor?
o: Because of Hitler's sudden rise in popularity
Because of the threat of war
questions.e: In the video: "Hindenburg je zbog naglog rasta Hitlerove popularnosti morao da ga imenuje za kancelara" — Hindenburg, because of Hitler's sudden rise in popularity, had to appoint him chancellor.

questions.q: What goals did Mussolini have?
o: To conquer Yugoslavia and the rest of the Balkans
To regain Italy's colonies in Asia
questions.e: In the video: "Musolini je imao daleko veće ciljeve, osvajanje Jugoslavije i ostatka Balkana" — Mussolini had far bigger goals, the conquest of Yugoslavia and the rest of the Balkans.

questions.q: What did Britain and France do when Hitler sent troops into the Rhineland?
questions.e: In the video: "Hitler šalje 3000 vojnika i uspostavlja neospornu vlast u regionu" — Hitler sends 3000 soldiers and establishes undisputed power in the region.

questions.q: What did they “forget” to do at the Munich conference?
questions.e: In the video: "nekako su zaboravili da pozovu upravo Čehoslovačku na tu konferenciju" — somehow they forgot to invite Czechoslovakia itself to that conference.

questions.q: What did the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact provide for?
o: The division of central Europe between two states
A joint war against the USA
questions.e: In the video: "potpisuju pakt o nenapadanju koji je omogućio podelu centralne Evrope između dve države" — sign a non-aggression pact which enabled the division of central Europe between the two states.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Nemačka jednostavno nije imala tu *kintu*.
questions.e: kinta — money (slang).

questions.q: Nezaposlenost je sa 30% pala na skoro *nulu*.
questions.e: nula — zero.

questions.q: Spaljivanje knjiga, *streljanje* političkih neistomišljenika
questions.e: streljanje — shooting.

questions.q: Ok, Rajna je sada *nesumnjivo* Nemačka.
questions.e: nesumnjivo — undoubtedly.

questions.q: Hitler je iskoristio taj *izgovor* kako bi opravdao okupaciju Sudeta
questions.e: izgovor — excuse.

questions.q: Nemačka je bila obavezna da plati ono što je danas *ekvivalent* 250 milijardi dolara.
questions.e: ekvivalent — equivalent.

questions.q: Njihova banka je *propadala*
questions.e: propadati — to fail, collapse.

questions.q: Nemački narod je sistematski *učen* da je pripadnik nadmoćne arijevske rase
questions.e: učen — taught.

questions.q: Prvi svetski rat se završio, a četiri carstva su ___
questions.e: Carstva (neut. pl.) takes pala.

questions.q: Italiji je u Londonskom sporazumu iz 1915. ___ mnogo toga
questions.e: Impersonal passive with dative: Italiji je obećano.

questions.q: morao da ga ___ za kancelara
questions.e: After da — present tense: da ga imenuje.

questions.q: Nezaposlenost je sa 30% pala ___ skoro nulu.
questions.e: Pasti na + acc.: to fall to zero.

questions.q: Ubrzo počinje i naoružavanje ___
questions.e: Naoružavanje + gen.: arming of the country.

questions.q: Nemački narod je sistematski učen da je pripadnik nadmoćne arijevske ___
questions.e: Pripadnik + gen.: member of the race.

questions.q: Britanci i Francuzi ne ___ ništa.
questions.e: Present tense: ne rade ništa.

questions.q: Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo i Francuska sa svim svojim ___ širom sveta
questions.e: Sa + instr. pl.: sa svim svojim kolonijama.
